row.diff:
diff --git a/envfile.py b/envfile.py
index b321663..486aa24 100644
--- a/envfile.py
+++ b/envfile.py
@@ -2,9 +2,16 @@
 
 
 def parse(text):
-    """Turn the file contents into a dict."""
+    """Turn the file contents into a dict.
+
+    Blank/whitespace-only lines and note lines (first non-space character
+    is '#') are skipped. A '#' anywhere else is part of the value.
+    """
     settings = {}
     for line in text.splitlines():
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
+            continue
         key, value = line.split("=", 1)
         settings[key.strip()] = value.strip()
     return settings
diff --git a/tests/test_envfile.py b/tests/test_envfile.py
index 0894693..3050852 100644
--- a/tests/test_envfile.py
+++ b/tests/test_envfile.py
@@ -13,3 +13,25 @@ def test_load(tmp_path):
     p = tmp_path / "deploy.env"
     p.write_text("HOST=web1\n", encoding="utf-8")
     assert envfile.load(p) == {"HOST": "web1"}
+
+
+def test_skips_notes_and_blank_lines():
+    text = "# header note\n\nA=1\n   \n\t\n# another note\nB=2\n"
+    assert envfile.parse(text) == {"A": "1", "B": "2"}
+
+
+def test_indented_note_is_skipped():
+    assert envfile.parse("  # indented note\nA=1") == {"A": "1"}
+
+
+def test_hash_inside_value_is_kept():
+    text = "PASSWORD=abc#def\nOTHER=#leading\nTRAIL=x #y"
+    assert envfile.parse(text) == {
+        "PASSWORD": "abc#def",
+        "OTHER": "#leading",
+        "TRAIL": "x #y",
+    }
+
+
+def test_only_notes_and_blanks_gives_empty_dict():
+    assert envfile.parse("# a\n\n  \n# b") == {}
